title: First full 17-shard TS-HA@OSGO baseline

changes: Scratch copy of tools/abaplint-tests-all.mjs uses repository module paths.
Log genuine FAIL and continue instead of throwing from assertNoFailures; preserve raw results before ownership filtering.
Retain per-shard artifacts after summary and retain OSG frontend refusal inventory.
Scratch host bridge validates explicitly supplied OSG commit rather than the repository pin; all other host checks remain unchanged.
B scratch runner points to the isolated origin/integ/o2 worktree and its modules; both use one worker.

countingRule: Original Node-active denominator 11,060. Pending 32 excluded. Infra is the count of active tests without a trustworthy runner report; that shard has null outcome counts. Unregistered counts only measured active registration omissions. Totals of outcome columns sum measured shards only. FAIL is a wrong answer and is never relabeled. No product or upstream test changes.
normalizationRule: Remove lowering-trap prefix, source node IDs/locations, owning-body metadata, generated hashes/addresses; deduplicate and sort repeated source-node-prefixed refusal reasons, preserving punctuation within each reason. One normalized composite message per trapped owned active test, so groups are disjoint and sum to traps. Static refusal-site counts and initialization messages are not test traps.
zoneRule: chai/json/json5/string/xml/harness/hooks and regexp helpers = abapiti; other operation emission/ABI/array storage = dell. Mixed messages list both zones. Generic native exceptions are provisional dell runtime/storage handoffs; their text does not identify a root cause.
sourceSiteRule: Use diagnostic TS location if exposed; otherwise generated ABAP location; otherwise original literal test registration location. Registration sites identify the original test, not the failing operation.
